trades.thesis: XOM bull flag breakout on Iran strikes catalyst, energy sector momentum leader
MongoDB crashed 27% on Q4 FY2026 earnings beat — classic overreaction. Revenue $695M (+27% YoY) and EPS $1.65 beat estimates. Atlas grew 29%. Selloff was purely soft Q1 guidance reaction.

Microsoft down 25% from peak despite blowout Q2 FY2026 — $81.3B revenue (+17%), Azure +39%, EPS $4.14 beating by 7%. At 23x fwd PE cheapest in 3 years. Market punishing CapEx but $625B RPO backlog proves spending generates returns.
Burlington Stores Q4 EPS $4.99 vs $4.71 est (+6% beat), FY2026 guidance raised to $10.95-$11.45, gap up 7% with analyst upgrades to $335-$375. Off-price retail is tariff-neutral consumer anchor.
Oracle down ~50% from ATH at $155, cheapest large-cap cloud infra at 18x fwd PE. $553B RPO backlog (325% YoY), 84% OCI growth, 44% cloud growth. Fiscal Q3 earnings March 10 is the catalyst.
